method: Exports extracted from the TS source of each partial parity-map module (export declarations and re-exports); mapped to Rust by name (snake_case/SCREAMING_CASE/Native-for-Node) with manual dispositions for the rest. Evidence = a Rust test/example/inline test naming the item, or use by another source file whose paths the stock suites exercise. Members of exported classes/interfaces are checked by name against Rust fns/fields. Verdict partial when any export has no native item or no evidence.
